label: D2 arrival at S2 after an unrewarded trial that was not at S2 (moving from unrewarded S1 to S2)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state is S2 (it never fires at D1, at GO, or at S1). Among S2 arrivals it fires on just 23%. It never fires when the previous trial was also at S2 and was rewarded, and almost never when the previous trial was at S2 and unrewarded (precision 0.04). It is selective for S2 arrivals that follow a trial in S1 (prev_state==1: P 0.58, R 0.80). Activations are strongest and most reliable when that S1 trial went unrewarded (prev_state==1 & prev_reward==0: P 0.85). The top windows are mostly ones where the agent leaves an unrewarded S1 and lands in S2. prev_state != 2 also keeps the first trial of each window, where the previous state is unknown to us. Recorded predicate D2 & S2 & prev_state!=2 & prev_reward==0: dev P 0.75, R 0.70, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.87. Adding switch trials (stay==0) helps only slightly (F1 0.74). The remaining activity is weaker, e.g. S2 arrivals after a rewarded S1 trial (P 0.33, 11% of mass). Activity falls steadily over the episode and is near zero in trials 90-99. Every variable used is observed by D2.
